BSCS agreed practice

Do Now

Start calmly with independent retrieval and purposeful review.

On this pageTechniques in the BSCS modelProfessional judgement

First phase of the lesson. Retrieval-based task that begins immediately, activates prior knowledge, ensures early success, and establishes a purposeful start to learning.

Techniques in the BSCS model

Do Now; Timer; Threshold; Activate prior knowledge; Engineer success

Professional judgement

Select and sequence techniques in response to the curriculum content and the pupils. The model may repeat within one lesson or span several lessons. These techniques are not a checklist to use all at once.

Source and status

BSCS Teaching and Learning Policy, June 2026, model of highly effective teaching.
